    package domain
    
    import (
        "bytes"
        "image"
        _ "image/jpeg"
        _ "image/png"
        "strings"
    )
    
    const MaxPhotoBytes = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    
    type ValidationErrors map[string]string
    
    func (e ValidationErrors) Error() string { return "Bitte die markierten Felder prüfen." }
    
    func ValidateName(name string) (string, error) {
        name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
        if name == "" {
            return "", ValidationErrors{"name": "Bitte einen Namen oder eine Bezeichnung eingeben."}
        }
        return name, nil
    }
    
    // ValidatePerson normalizes and validates a complete replacement before storage.
    func ValidatePerson(p Person) (Person, error) {
        p.Name = strings.TrimSpace(p.Name)
        p.DocumentType = strings.TrimSpace(p.DocumentType)
        p.DocumentDescription = strings.TrimSpace(p.DocumentDescription)
        p.DocumentNumber = strings.TrimSpace(p.DocumentNumber)
        e := ValidationErrors{}
        if p.Name == "" {
            e["name"] = "Bitte einen Namen eingeben."
        }
        if len(p.Photo) > 0 {
            if p.DocumentType != "" || p.DocumentDescription != "" || p.DocumentNumber != "" {
                e["proof"] = "Bitte genau eine Nachweisart verwenden."
            }
            if len(p.Photo) > MaxPhotoBytes {
                e["photo"] = "Das Foto darf höchstens 5 MiB groß sein."
            } else {
                cfg, format, err := image.DecodeConfig(bytes.NewReader(p.Photo))
                if err != nil || (format != "jpeg" && format != "png") || cfg.Width <= 0 || cfg.Height <= 0 || int64(cfg.Width)*int64(cfg.Height) > 20_000_000 {
                    e["photo"] = "Bitte ein gültiges JPEG oder PNG mit höchstens 20 Millionen Pixeln wählen."
                } else if _, _, err := image.Decode(bytes.NewReader(p.Photo)); err != nil {
                    e["photo"] = "Das Foto ist beschädigt und kann nicht gelesen werden."
                } else if p.PhotoType != "image/"+format {
                    e["photo"] = "Der angegebene Dateityp stimmt nicht mit dem Bildinhalt überein."
                }
            }
        } else {
            switch p.DocumentType {
            case "Personalausweis", "Reisepass", "Führerschein", "Sonstiger Ausweis":
            default:
                e["documentType"] = "Bitte eine gültige Ausweisart wählen."
            }
            if p.DocumentNumber == "" {
                e["documentNumber"] = "Bitte eine Ausweisnummer eingeben."
            }
            if p.DocumentType == "Sonstiger Ausweis" && p.DocumentDescription == "" {
                e["documentDescription"] = "Bitte den sonstigen Ausweis bezeichnen."
            }
            if p.DocumentType != "Sonstiger Ausweis" {
                p.DocumentDescription = ""
            }
            p.PhotoType = ""
        }
        if len(e) > 0 {
            return Person{}, e
        }
        p.Photo = bytes.Clone(p.Photo)
        return p, nil
    }
    // Package domain defines the initial SkiRental data model.
    package domain
    
    import "time"
    
    // Person represents a customer. Identity data must not appear in overview pages.
    type Person struct {
        ID                  string `json:"id"`
        Name                string `json:"name"`
        DocumentType        string `json:"documentType,omitempty"`
        DocumentDescription string `json:"documentDescription,omitempty"`
        DocumentNumber      string `json:"documentNumber,omitempty"`
        Photo               []byte `json:"-"`
        PhotoType           string `json:"-"`
        PhotoURL            string `json:"photoURL,omitempty"`
    }
    
    // Ski represents a pair of skis rented and returned together.
    type Ski struct {
        ID   string `json:"id"`
        Name string `json:"name"`
    }
    
    // Rental separates the agreed calendar period from actual issue and return.
    type Rental struct {
        ID              string
        CreatedAt       time.Time
        StartsOn        string
        EndsOn          string
        DurationDays    int
        TotalPriceCents int64
        TariffVersion   uint64
        CancelledAt     time.Time
        PersonID        string
        SkiID           string
        RentedAt        time.Time
        ReturnedAt      time.Time
    }
    // Package store provides the process-local, concurrency-safe application state.
    package store
    
    import (
        "bytes"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "sort"
        "sync"
        "time"
    
        "bikerental/internal/domain"
    )
    
    type Store struct {
        mu         sync.RWMutex
        now        func() time.Time
        tariff     domain.Tariff
        nextPerson uint64
        nextSki    uint64
        nextRental uint64
        demo       bool
        people     map[string]domain.Person
        skis       map[string]domain.Ski
        rentals    map[string]domain.Rental
    }
    
    // Snapshot contains independent value copies in stable ID order.
    type Snapshot struct {
        People  []domain.Person
        Skis    []domain.Ski
        Rentals []domain.Rental
    }
    
    func New(demo bool) *Store {
        s := &Store{
            demo:    demo,
            now:     time.Now,
            tariff:  domain.Tariff{PricesCents: []int64{}},
            people:  make(map[string]domain.Person),
            skis:    make(map[string]domain.Ski),
            rentals: make(map[string]domain.Rental),
        }
        if demo {
            s.SeedDemo()
        }
        return s
    }
    
    // IsDemo is immutable for the lifetime of the store.
    func (s *Store) IsDemo() bool { return s.demo }
    
    // SeedDemo is idempotent and does not overwrite existing records.
    // Normal-mode stores remain empty unless future business operations add data.
    func (s *Store) SeedDemo() {
        if !s.demo {
            return
        }
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
    
        if s.tariff.Version == 0 {
            s.tariff = domain.Tariff{Version: 1, PricesCents: []int64{2500, 4500, 6000}, ExtraDayCents: 1500}
        }
        person := domain.Person{
            ID: "demo-person-01", Name: "Demo Person",
            DocumentType: "Sonstiger Ausweis", DocumentDescription: "Demoausweis",
            DocumentNumber: "DEMO-0001",
        }
        if _, exists := s.people[person.ID]; !exists {
            s.people[person.ID] = person
        }
        for _, ski := range []domain.Ski{
            {ID: "demo-ski-01", Name: "Demo Ski-Paar 01"},
            {ID: "demo-ski-02", Name: "Demo Ski-Paar 02"},
        } {
            if _, exists := s.skis[ski.ID]; !exists {
                s.skis[ski.ID] = ski
            }
        }
    }
    
    func (s *Store) Snapshot() Snapshot {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        result := Snapshot{
            People:  make([]domain.Person, 0, len(s.people)),
            Skis:    make([]domain.Ski, 0, len(s.skis)),
            Rentals: make([]domain.Rental, 0, len(s.rentals)),
        }
        for _, person := range s.people {
            result.People = append(result.People, clonePerson(person))
        }
        for _, ski := range s.skis {
            result.Skis = append(result.Skis, ski)
        }
        for _, rental := range s.rentals {
            result.Rentals = append(result.Rentals, rental)
        }
        sort.Slice(result.People, func(i, j int) bool { return result.People[i].ID < result.People[j].ID })
        sort.Slice(result.Skis, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Skis[i].ID < result.Skis[j].ID })
        sort.Slice(result.Rentals, func(i, j int) bool { return result.Rentals[i].ID < result.Rentals[j].ID })
        return result
    }
    
    var ErrNotFound = errors.New("Datensatz nicht gefunden")
    
    func clonePerson(p domain.Person) domain.Person { p.Photo = bytes.Clone(p.Photo); return p }
    
    func (s *Store) Person(id string) (domain.Person, error) {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        p, ok := s.people[id]
        if !ok {
            return domain.Person{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        return clonePerson(p), nil
    }
    func (s *Store) Ski(id string) (domain.Ski, error) {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        p, ok := s.skis[id]
        if !ok {
            return domain.Ski{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        return p, nil
    }
    func (s *Store) SaveSki(id, name string) (domain.Ski, error) {
        name, err := domain.ValidateName(name)
        if err != nil {
            return domain.Ski{}, err
        }
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        if id == "" {
            s.nextSki++
            id = fmt.Sprintf("ski-%06d", s.nextSki)
        } else if _, ok := s.skis[id]; !ok {
            return domain.Ski{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        p := domain.Ski{ID: id, Name: name}
        s.skis[id] = p
        return p, nil
    }
    
    // SavePerson validates the entire candidate under the same lock as replacement.
    // keepProof permits name-only edits without sending the previous identity data.
    func (s *Store) SavePerson(id string, p domain.Person, keepProof bool) (domain.Person, error) {
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        old, exists := s.people[id]
        if id != "" && !exists {
            return domain.Person{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        if keepProof {
            if id == "" || len(p.Photo) > 0 || p.DocumentNumber != "" || p.DocumentType != "" || p.DocumentDescription != "" {
                return domain.Person{}, domain.ValidationErrors{"proof": "Unverändert ist nur ohne neuen Nachweis bei vorhandenen Personen möglich."}
            }
            name := p.Name
            p = old
            p.Name = name
        }
        p, err := domain.ValidatePerson(p)
        if err != nil {
            return domain.Person{}, err
        }
        if id == "" {
            s.nextPerson++
            id = fmt.Sprintf("person-%06d", s.nextPerson)
        }
        p.ID = id
        p.PhotoURL = ""
        s.people[id] = p
        return clonePerson(p), nil
    }
    
    // People exposes only the fields needed by overview callers, without photo copies.
    func (s *Store) People() []domain.Person {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        result := make([]domain.Person, 0, len(s.people))
        for _, p := range s.people {
            result = append(result, domain.Person{ID: p.ID, Name: p.Name})
        }
        sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].ID < result[j].ID })
        return result
    }
    func (s *Store) Skis() []domain.Ski {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        result := make([]domain.Ski, 0, len(s.skis))
        for _, p := range s.skis {
            result = append(result, p)
        }
        sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].ID < result[j].ID })
        return result
    }
    package handler
    
    import (
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "io"
        "mime"
        "net/http"
    
        "bikerental/internal/domain"
        "bikerental/internal/store"
    )
    
    func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        w.WriteHeader(status)
        _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
    }
    func apiError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
        status := 400
        fields := domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Die Anfrage ist ungültig."}
        var validation domain.ValidationErrors
        var size *http.MaxBytesError
        var missing store.MissingReference
        var conflict store.Conflict
        if errors.As(err, &validation) {
            fields = validation
        } else if errors.As(err, &missing) {
            status = 404
            fields = domain.ValidationErrors{missing.Field: missing.Error()}
        } else if errors.As(err, &conflict) {
            status = 409
            fields = domain.ValidationErrors{conflict.Field: conflict.Message}
        } else if errors.Is(err, store.ErrUnavailable) {
            status = 409
            fields = domain.ValidationErrors{"skiID": store.ErrUnavailable.Error()}
        } else if errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
            status = 404
            fields["form"] = "Der Datensatz wurde nicht gefunden."
        } else if errors.As(err, &size) {
            status = 413
            fields = domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Die Anfrage ist zu groß. Bitte die Eingaben verkleinern."}
            if size.Limit == domain.MaxPhotoBytes {
                fields = domain.ValidationErrors{"photo": "Das Foto darf höchstens 5 MiB groß sein."}
            }
        }
        writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"errors": fields})
    }
    func exposePerson(p domain.Person) domain.Person {
        if len(p.Photo) > 0 {
            p.PhotoURL = "/api/personen/" + p.ID + "/foto"
        }
        return p
    }
    func registerAPI(mux *http.ServeMux, s *store.Store) {
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/ski", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { writeJSON(w, 200, s.Skis()) })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/ski/{id}", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            p, err := s.Ski(r.PathValue("id"))
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, p)
        })
        skiWrite := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            media, _, _ := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
            if media != "application/json" {
                writeJSON(w, 415, map[string]any{"errors": domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "JSON erwartet."}})
                return
            }
            r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64*1024)
            var input struct {
                Name string `json:"name"`
            }
            dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
            dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
            if err := dec.Decode(&input); err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            if err := dec.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
                if err == nil {
                    err = errors.New("extra JSON")
                }
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            p, err := s.SaveSki(r.PathValue("id"), input.Name)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            status := 200
            if r.Method == "POST" {
                status = 201
                w.Header().Set("Location", "/api/ski/"+p.ID)
            }
            writeJSON(w, status, p)
        }
        mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/ski", skiWrite)
        mux.HandleFunc("PUT /api/ski/{id}", skiWrite)
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/personen", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            // A dedicated DTO guarantees that even empty identity fields are absent.
            type summary struct {
                ID   string `json:"id"`
                Name string `json:"name"`
            }
            list := []summary{}
            for _, p := range s.People() {
                list = append(list, summary{p.ID, p.Name})
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, list)
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/personen/{id}", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            p, err := s.Person(r.PathValue("id"))
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, exposePerson(p))
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/personen/{id}/foto", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            p, err := s.Person(r.PathValue("id"))
            if err == nil && len(p.Photo) == 0 {
                err = store.ErrNotFound
            }
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            w.Header().Set("Content-Type", p.PhotoType)
            if r.Method != "HEAD" {
                _, _ = w.Write(p.Photo)
            }
        })
        personWrite := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            media, _, _ := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
            if media != "multipart/form-data" {
                writeJSON(w, 415, map[string]any{"errors": domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Multipart-Formular erwartet."}})
                return
            }
            p, keep, err := readPerson(w, r)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            p, err = s.SavePerson(r.PathValue("id"), p, keep)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            status := 200
            if r.Method == "POST" {
                status = 201
                w.Header().Set("Location", "/api/personen/"+p.ID)
            }
            writeJSON(w, status, exposePerson(p))
        }
        mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/personen", personWrite)
        mux.HandleFunc("PUT /api/personen/{id}", personWrite)
    }
    
    func readPerson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (domain.Person, bool, error) {
        var p domain.Person
        r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, domain.MaxPhotoBytes+64*1024)
        reader, err := r.MultipartReader()
        if err != nil {
            return p, false, err
        }
        fields := map[string]string{}
        seen := map[string]bool{}
        for {
            part, err := reader.NextPart()
            if err == io.EOF {
                break
            }
            if err != nil {
                return p, false, err
            }
            name := part.FormName()
            if seen[name] {
                return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Doppelte Formularfelder sind ungültig."}
            }
            seen[name] = true
            limit := int64(8192)
            if name == "photo" {
                limit = domain.MaxPhotoBytes + 1
            }
            data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(part, limit+1))
            if err != nil {
                return p, false, err
            }
            if int64(len(data)) > limit || (name == "photo" && len(data) > domain.MaxPhotoBytes) {
                return p, false, &http.MaxBytesError{Limit: domain.MaxPhotoBytes}
            }
            if name == "photo" {
                p.Photo = data
                p.PhotoType, _, _ = mime.ParseMediaType(part.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
            } else {
                switch name {
                case "name", "proof", "documentType", "documentDescription", "documentNumber":
                    fields[name] = string(data)
                default:
                    return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Unbekanntes Formularfeld."}
                }
                if part.FileName() != "" {
                    return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Unerwartete Datei."}
                }
            }
            _ = part.Close()
        }
        p.Name = fields["name"]
        p.DocumentType = fields["documentType"]
        p.DocumentDescription = fields["documentDescription"]
        p.DocumentNumber = fields["documentNumber"]
        switch fields["proof"] {
        case "keep":
            if seen["photo"] {
                return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"proof": "Zum Beibehalten bitte keinen neuen Nachweis senden."}
            }
            return p, true, nil
        case "manual":
            if seen["photo"] {
                return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"proof": "Bitte genau eine Nachweisart verwenden."}
            }
        case "photo":
            if len(p.Photo) == 0 {
                return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"photo": "Bitte ein Foto auswählen."}
            }
        default:
            return p, false, domain.ValidationErrors{"proof": "Bitte eine Nachweisart wählen."}
        }
        return p, false, nil
    }

        if(formGeneration!==generation)return;

       } catch(error) {if(formGeneration!==generation)return;showErrors(error); button.disabled=false;}
      });
     }
     async function render() {

Lege den ersten Eintrag an.</p>`}</div>`;
       }

     window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{

    'use strict';
    (() => {
     if (!document.querySelector('#ausleihe')) return;
     const content=document.querySelector('#rental-content'),message=document.querySelector('#rental-message');
     const esc=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
     const money=value=>new Intl.NumberFormat('de-AT').format(BigInt(value)/100n)+','+(BigInt(value)%100n).toString().padStart(2,'0')+' €';
     const date=value=>value?esc(new Date(value).toLocaleString('de-AT')):'';
     const calendar=value=>esc(value.split('-').reverse().join('.'));
     const today=()=>new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Europe/Vienna',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());
     const initialPerson=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('person')||'';
     let generation=0;
     document.querySelector('.skip-link').addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();document.querySelector('main').focus();});
     async function request(url,options) {
      const response=await fetch(url,{cache:'no-store',...options});const result=await response.json();
      if(!response.ok)throw {errors:result.errors,status:response.status};return result;
     }
     const post=(url,data)=>request(url,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(data)});
     function notice(text){message.textContent=text;message.className=text?'success':'';}
     function showErrors(error){
      content.querySelectorAll('.field-error').forEach(el=>el.textContent='');
      content.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid]').forEach(el=>el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid'));
      const errors=error.errors||{form:'Die Verbindung ist fehlgeschlagen. Bitte erneut versuchen.'};
      const summary=content.querySelector('#rental-error');summary.textContent=Object.values(errors).join(' ');
      for(const [key,text]of Object.entries(errors)){
       const field=document.getElementById('rental-error-'+key);if(field)field.textContent=text;
       document.getElementById(key)?.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');
      }
      summary.focus();
     }
     const field=(id,label,input)=>`<div class="field"><label for="${id}">${label}</label>${input}<small class="field-error" id="rental-error-${id}"></small></div>`;
     const options=list=>list.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v.id)}">${esc(v.name)} · ${esc(v.id)}</option>`).join('');
     const stateNames={booked:'Gebucht',expired:'Abgelaufen · nicht ausgegeben',issued:'Ausgegeben',returned:'Zurückgegeben',cancelled:'Storniert'};
     function rentalList(list){
      if(!list.length)return '<p>Noch keine Einträge.</p>';
      return `<ul class="rental-list">${list.map(r=>`<li class="rental-card"><p class="record-id">${esc(r.id)}</p><h3>${esc(r.skiName)}</h3><p>Ski-ID: ${esc(r.skiID)}<br>Person: <a href="/personen#${encodeURIComponent(r.personID)}">${esc(r.personName)}</a> · ${esc(r.personID)}</p><p>${calendar(r.startsOn)} – ${calendar(r.endsOn)} · ${r.durationDays} ${r.durationDays===1?'Tag':'Tage'}<br><strong>Vereinbarter Preis: ${money(r.totalPriceCents)}</strong></p><p>Gebucht: ${date(r.createdAt)}${r.rentedAt?`<br>Ausgegeben: ${date(r.rentedAt)}`:''}${r.returnedAt?`<br>Zurückgegeben: ${date(r.returnedAt)}`:''}${r.cancelledAt?`<br>Storniert: ${date(r.cancelledAt)}`:''}</p><span class="returned-badge ${r.overdue?'overdue':''}">${esc(stateNames[r.status])}${r.overdue?' · Überfällig':''}</span><div class="actions">${r.status==='booked'&&r.startsOn<=today()?`<button data-action="ausgabe" data-id="${esc(r.id)}">Ski ausgeben</button>`:''}${r.status==='booked'||r.status==='expired'?`<button class="secondary" data-action="stornierung" data-id="${esc(r.id)}">Buchung stornieren</button>`:''}${r.status==='issued'?`<button data-action="rueckgabe" data-id="${esc(r.id)}">Rückgabe erfassen</button>`:''}</div></li>`).join('')}</ul>`;
     }
     function headingFocus(){const h=content.querySelector('h2');if(h){h.tabIndex=-1;h.focus();}}
     async function render(saved={personID:initialPerson,startsOn:today(),endsOn:today()}){
      const own=++generation;content.innerHTML='<p>Ausleihen werden geladen …</p>';
      try{
       const [people,rentals,tariff]=await Promise.all([request('/api/personen'),request('/api/ausleihen'),request('/api/tarife')]);
       if(own!==generation)return;
       const overview=location.hash==='#uebersicht';
       content.innerHTML=`<div class="section-heading"><h2>${overview?'Buchungen, Ausgabe und Rückgabe':'Ausleihe buchen'}</h2><div class="actions compact"><button class="secondary" id="refresh-rentals">Aktualisieren</button>${overview?'<a class="button" href="#neu">Neue Ausleihe</a>':''}</div></div><p id="rental-error" class="field-error" role="alert" tabindex="-1"></p>${!overview?`<form id="rental-form" class="record-panel" novalidate><p>Beginn und geplante Rückgabe zählen beide als Verleihtag. Nach der Buchung die tatsächliche Ausgabe separat erfassen.</p>${!people.length?'<p>Noch keine Personen vorhanden. <a href="/personen#neu">Person anlegen</a></p>':''}${!tariff.version?'<p class="field-error">Noch kein Tarif eingerichtet. <a href="/tarife">Tarife verwalten</a></p>':''}${field('personID','Person (Pflichtfeld)',`<select id="personID" aria-describedby="rental-error-personID"><option value="">Bitte Person wählen</option>${options(people)}</select>`)}<div class="date-fields">${field('startsOn','Verleihbeginn (Pflichtfeld)',`<input type="date" id="startsOn" min="${today()}" value="${esc(saved.startsOn)}" aria-describedby="rental-error-startsOn">`)}${field('endsOn','Geplante Rückgabe (Pflichtfeld)',`<input type="date" id="endsOn" min="${today()}" value="${esc(saved.endsOn)}" aria-describedby="rental-error-endsOn">`)}</div><button type="button" class="secondary" id="check-period" ${!tariff.version?'disabled':''}>Verfügbarkeit und Preis prüfen</button><p id="price-preview" role="status">Bitte den Zeitraum prüfen.</p>${field('skiID','Verfügbares Ski-Paar im Zeitraum (Pflichtfeld)','<select id="skiID" disabled aria-describedby="rental-error-skiID"><option value="">Bitte zuerst Zeitraum prüfen</option></select>')}<p id="no-skis" hidden>Keine Paare im Zeitraum verfügbar. Einen anderen Zeitraum wählen, eine Rückgabe erfassen oder <a href="/ski#neu">ein Ski-Paar anlegen</a>.</p><div class="actions"><button type="submit" disabled>Zum angezeigten Preis buchen</button><a class="button secondary" href="#uebersicht">Abbrechen</a></div></form>`:''}${[['Gebuchte Ausleihen',['booked','expired']],['Ausgegebene Ausleihen',['issued']],['Abgeschlossene Ausleihen',['returned']],['Stornierte Buchungen',['cancelled']]].map(([title,statuses],i)=>`<section class="rental-section" aria-labelledby="rental-title-${i}"><h2 id="rental-title-${i}">${title}</h2>${rentalList(rentals.filter(r=>statuses.includes(r.status)))}</section>`).join('')}`;
       const form=content.querySelector('#rental-form');let quote=null,previewGeneration=0;
       const values=()=>form?{personID:document.querySelector('#personID').value,startsOn:document.querySelector('#startsOn').value,endsOn:document.querySelector('#endsOn').value}:saved;
       if(form){
        const person=form.querySelector('#personID'),ski=form.querySelector('#skiID'),submit=form.querySelector('[type="submit"]'),check=form.querySelector('#check-period'),preview=form.querySelector('#price-preview');
        person.value=people.some(p=>p.id===saved.personID)?saved.personID:'';
        if(saved.personID&&!person.value)showErrors({errors:{personID:'Die vorausgewählte Person wurde nicht gefunden. Bitte eine vorhandene Person auswählen.'}});
        function invalidate(){quote=null;previewGeneration++;ski.innerHTML='<option value="">Bitte zuerst Zeitraum prüfen</option>';ski.disabled=true;submit.disabled=true;check.disabled=!tariff.version;form.querySelector('#no-skis').hidden=true;preview.textContent='Zeitraum geändert. Bitte Verfügbarkeit und Preis erneut prüfen.';}
        for(const id of ['startsOn','endsOn'])form.querySelector('#'+id).addEventListener('input',invalidate);
        async function loadPreview(){
         const attempt=++previewGeneration;quote=null;submit.disabled=true;ski.disabled=true;check.disabled=true;preview.textContent='Verfügbarkeit und Preis werden geprüft …';
         const selected=values();
         try{
          const [price,pairs]=await Promise.all([post('/api/ausleihen/preis',{startsOn:selected.startsOn,endsOn:selected.endsOn}),request('/api/ski/verfuegbar?'+new URLSearchParams({startsOn:selected.startsOn,endsOn:selected.endsOn}))]);
          if(own!==generation||attempt!==previewGeneration)return;
          quote=price;form.querySelector('#no-skis').hidden=!!pairs.length;ski.innerHTML='<option value="">Bitte Ski-Paar wählen</option>'+options(pairs);ski.disabled=!pairs.length;
          preview.textContent=`${price.durationDays} ${price.durationDays===1?'Tag':'Tage'} · Gesamtpreis ${money(price.totalPriceCents)}${pairs.length?'':'. Keine Ski-Paare im Zeitraum verfügbar.'}`;
          submit.disabled=!pairs.length||!people.length;
         }catch(error){if(own!==generation||attempt!==previewGeneration)return;preview.textContent='Der Zeitraum konnte nicht geprüft werden.';showErrors(error);}
         finally{if(own===generation&&attempt===previewGeneration)check.disabled=false;}
        }
        check.addEventListener('click',loadPreview);
        form.addEventListener('submit',async event=>{
         event.preventDefault();if(!quote)return;
         const current=values();submit.disabled=true;
         try{
          await post('/api/ausleihen',{...current,skiID:ski.value,tariffVersion:quote.tariffVersion});
          if(own!==generation)return;notice('Buchung gespeichert. Die tatsächliche Ausgabe bitte separat erfassen.');await render(current);message.focus();
         }catch(error){
          if(own!==generation)return;
          if(error.status===409){await loadPreview();if(own!==generation)return;}
          else submit.disabled=!quote;
          showErrors(error);
         }
        });
       }
       content.querySelector('#refresh-rentals').addEventListener('click',()=>{notice('');render(values()).then(headingFocus);});
       content.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',async()=>{
        button.disabled=true;
        try{
         await request('/api/ausleihen/'+encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id)+'/'+button.dataset.action,{method:'PUT'});
         if(own!==generation)return;
         notice({ausgabe:'Ausgabe gespeichert.',rueckgabe:'Rückgabe gespeichert.',stornierung:'Buchung storniert.'}[button.dataset.action]);
         await render(values());message.focus();
        }catch(error){if(own!==generation)return;showErrors(error);button.disabled=false;}
       }));
      }catch(error){
       if(own!==generation)return;
       content.innerHTML='<p id="rental-error" class="field-error" role="alert" tabindex="-1"></p><button id="retry-rentals">Erneut laden</button>';
       showErrors(error);content.querySelector('#retry-rentals').addEventListener('click',()=>render(saved));
      }
     }
     window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{notice('');render().then(headingFocus);});
     render();
    })();
    package handler
    
    import (
        "bytes"
        "encoding/json"
        "image"
        "image/png"

    func call(t *testing.T, app http.Handler, method, path, kind string, body io.Reader, status int) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
        t.Helper()
        r := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, body)
        if kind != "" {
            r.Header.Set("Content-Type", kind)
        }
        w := httptest.NewRecorder()
        app.ServeHTTP(w, r)
        if w.Code != status {
            t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %d want %d: %s", method, path, w.Code, status, w.Body.String())
        }
        if w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
            t.Fatal("missing cache protection")
        }
        return w
    }
    func personRequest(t *testing.T, app http.Handler, method, path string, fields map[string]string, photo []byte, mime string, status int) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
        t.Helper()
        var b bytes.Buffer
        writer := multipart.NewWriter(&b)
        for k, v := range fields {
            if err := writer.WriteField(k, v); err != nil {
                t.Fatal(err)
            }
        }
        if photo != nil {
            h := textproto.MIMEHeader{}
            h.Set("Content-Disposition", `form-data; name="photo"; filename="synthetic.png"`)
            h.Set("Content-Type", mime)
            part, err := writer.CreatePart(h)
            if err != nil {
                t.Fatal(err)
            }
            _, _ = part.Write(photo)
        }
        _ = writer.Close()
        return call(t, app, method, path, writer.FormDataContentType(), &b, status)
    }
    func TestManagementAPI(t *testing.T) {
        s := store.New(false)
        app, err := New(s)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        ski := call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":" Test Ski "}`), 201)
        var sk domain.Ski
        _ = json.Unmarshal(ski.Body.Bytes(), &sk)
        if sk.Name != "Test Ski" || ski.Header().Get("Location") != "/api/ski/"+sk.ID {
            t.Fatal("ski creation")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "", nil, 200)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"Edited"}`), 200)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":" "}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X","id":"override"}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X"} {}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "text/plain", strings.NewReader(`{}`), 415)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/missing", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/missing", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X"}`), 404)
        fields := map[string]string{"name": " Synthetic Person ", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Sonstiger Ausweis", "documentDescription": "Testdokument", "documentNumber": "TEST-42"}
        created := personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", fields, nil, "", 201)
        var p domain.Person
        _ = json.Unmarshal(created.Body.Bytes(), &p)
        path := "/api/personen/" + p.ID
        if p.Name != "Synthetic Person" || created.Header().Get("Location") != path {
            t.Fatal("person creation")
        }
        detail := call(t, app, "GET", path, "", nil, 200)
        if !strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "TEST-42") {
            t.Fatal("detail missing proof")
        }
        list := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen", "", nil, 200)
        var summaries []map[string]any
        _ = json.Unmarshal(list.Body.Bytes(), &summaries)
        if len(summaries) != 1 || len(summaries[0]) != 2 {
            t.Fatal("list exposes extra fields")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "Renamed", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 200)
        before := s.Snapshot()
        for _, bad := range []map[string]string{
            {"name": " ", "proof": "keep"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Unknown", "documentNumber": "X"},
            {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Reisepass"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Sonstiger Ausweis", "documentNumber": "X"},
            {"name": "X", "proof": "keep", "documentNumber": "X"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "photo"},
        } {
            personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, bad, nil, "", 400)
            if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
                t.Fatal("invalid edit mutated state")
            }
        }
        var pic bytes.Buffer
        _ = png.Encode(&pic, image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 2, 2)))
        photoFields := map[string]string{"name": "Photo Person", "proof": "photo"}
        for _, tc := range []struct {
            data   []byte
            mime   string
            status int
        }{
            {[]byte("broken"), "image/png", 400}, {pic.Bytes(), "image/jpeg", 400}, {pic.Bytes()[:len(pic.Bytes())-15], "image/png", 400}, {make([]byte, domain.MaxPhotoBytes+1), "image/png", 413},
        } {
            personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, photoFields, tc.data, tc.mime, tc.status)
            if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
                t.Fatal("invalid photo mutated state")
            }
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, photoFields, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 200)
        imageResponse := call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
        if !bytes.Equal(imageResponse.Body.Bytes(), pic.Bytes()) || imageResponse.Header().Get("Content-Type") != "image/png" {
            t.Fatal("wrong photo response")
        }
        detail = call(t, app, "GET", path, "", nil, 200)
        if strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "TEST-42") || !strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "photoURL") {
            t.Fatal("photo switch retained manual proof")
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "Photo renamed", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 200)
        imageResponse = call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
        if !bytes.Equal(imageResponse.Body.Bytes(), pic.Bytes()) {
            t.Fatal("keep changed photo")
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, fields, nil, "", 200)
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", "/api/personen/missing", fields, nil, "", 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 400)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen/missing", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen/missing/foto", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "DELETE", path, "", nil, 405)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{}`), 415)
        // A fresh process-local state never inherits edits or photos.
        if len(store.New(false).People()) != 0 {
            t.Fatal("fresh store inherited data")
        }
    }
    
    func TestMultipartBoundariesAndPhotoCreation(t *testing.T) {
        s := store.New(false)
        app, err := New(s)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        var pic bytes.Buffer
        _ = png.Encode(&pic, image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 2, 2)))
        fields := map[string]string{"name": "Photo creation", "proof": "photo"}
        created := personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", fields, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 201)
        var p domain.Person
        _ = json.Unmarshal(created.Body.Bytes(), &p)
        if p.PhotoURL == "" {
            t.Fatal("photo creation missing URL")
        }
        before := s.Snapshot()
        path := "/api/personen/" + p.ID
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "keep"}, []byte{}, "image/png", 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "photo", "documentType": "Reisepass", "documentNumber": "X"}, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "id": "override"}, nil, "", 400)
        var body bytes.Buffer
        writer := multipart.NewWriter(&body)
        _ = writer.WriteField("name", "A")
        _ = writer.WriteField("name", "B")
        _ = writer.Close()
        call(t, app, "PUT", path, writer.FormDataContentType(), &body, 400)
        call(t, app, "PUT", path, "multipart/form-data; boundary=broken", strings.NewReader("truncated"), 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": strings.Repeat("x", 9000), "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 413)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"`+strings.Repeat("x", 70000)+`"}`), 413)
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
            t.Fatal("malformed request mutated state")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski", "", nil, 200)
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
    }
    package store
    
    import (
        "bytes"
        "image"
        "image/png"
        "reflect"
        "sync"
        "testing"
    
        "bikerental/internal/domain"
    )
    
    func manual() domain.Person {
        return domain.Person{Name: " Test Person ", DocumentType: "Reisepass", DocumentNumber: " TEST-1 "}
    }
    func photo() domain.Person {
        var b bytes.Buffer
        _ = png.Encode(&b, image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 2, 2)))
        return domain.Person{Name: "Photo Person", Photo: b.Bytes(), PhotoType: "image/png"}
    }
    func TestManagementValidationAndAtomicReplacement(t *testing.T) {
        s := New(false)

    func TestConcurrentManagement(t *testing.T) {

                for range 15 {

                    if err != nil {

                    }

                    ski, err := s.SaveSki("", "Same name")
                    if err != nil {
                        t.Error(err)
                        return
                    }
                    if _, err := s.SaveSki(ski.ID, "Edited"); err != nil {
                        t.Error(err)
                    }

                    _, _ = s.Ski(ski.ID)
                    _ = s.Snapshot()
                    _ = s.People()
                    _ = s.Skis()
                    s.SeedDemo()

    func TestConcurrentEditsPreserveCompleteProof(t *testing.T) {
        s := New(false)
        p, err := s.SavePerson("", manual(), false)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        var wg sync.WaitGroup
        for worker := range 12 {
            wg.Go(func() {
                for range 30 {
                    if worker%2 == 0 {
                        _, localErr := s.SavePerson(p.ID, manual(), false)
                        if localErr != nil {
                            t.Error(localErr)
                        }
                    } else {
                        _, localErr := s.SavePerson(p.ID, domain.Person{Name: "Renamed"}, true)
                        if localErr != nil {
                            t.Error(localErr)
                        }
                    }
                    got, readErr := s.Person(p.ID)
                    if readErr != nil || got.ID != p.ID || got.Name == "" || got.DocumentNumber == "" {
                        t.Error("incomplete concurrent edit")
                    }
                }
            })
        }
        wg.Wait()
    }

    func TestStartModes(t *testing.T) {
        empty := New(false)
        empty.SeedDemo()
        if empty.IsDemo() || len(empty.Snapshot().People) != 0 || len(empty.Snapshot().Skis) != 0 || len(empty.Snapshot().Rentals) != 0 {
            t.Fatal("normal mode must start and remain empty")
        }
        demo := New(true)
        got := demo.Snapshot()
        if !demo.IsDemo() || len(got.People) != 1 || len(got.Skis) != 2 || len(got.Rentals) != 0 {

        }
        person := got.People[0]

            t.Fatalf("unexpected synthetic identity: %+v", person)
        }
        if got.Skis[0].Name != "Demo Ski-Paar 01" || got.Skis[1].Name != "Demo Ski-Paar 02" || got.Skis[0].ID == got.Skis[1].ID {
            t.Fatalf("expected two distinct, named ski pairs: %+v", got.Skis)
        }
        demo.SeedDemo()
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, demo.Snapshot()) {
            t.Fatal("repeated seeding changed the demo data")
        }
    }
    
    func TestSnapshotsAreIndependentAndRestartResetsState(t *testing.T) {
        s := New(true)
        original := s.Snapshot()
        copy := s.Snapshot()
        copy.People[0].DocumentNumber = "CHANGED"
        copy.Skis[0].Name = "CHANGED"
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(original, s.Snapshot()) {
            t.Fatal("snapshot exposed mutable internal state")
        }
    
        // Simulate a change from a future business operation without adding a CRUD API.
        s.mu.Lock()
        person := s.people["demo-person-01"]
        person.Name = "Edited Demo"
        s.people[person.ID] = person
        delete(s.skis, "demo-ski-02")
        s.mu.Unlock()
        s.SeedDemo()
        if s.Snapshot().People[0].Name != "Edited Demo" {
            t.Fatal("seeding overwrote an existing customer")
        }
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(original, New(true).Snapshot()) {
            t.Fatal("a restarted demo store inherited old state")
        }
        fresh := New(false).Snapshot()
        if len(fresh.People)+len(fresh.Skis)+len(fresh.Rentals) != 0 {
            t.Fatal("a restarted normal store inherited old state")
        }
    }
    
    func TestConcurrentSeedingAndSnapshots(t *testing.T) {

                        t.Error("concurrent access changed demo state or produced duplicates")

                    }
                }
            })
        }
        wg.Wait()
    }

    func TestMVPAcceptanceWorkflow(t *testing.T) {
        for _, demo := range []bool{false, true} {

                t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("demo=%t/%s", demo, proof), func(t *testing.T) {

                    s := store.New(demo)

                        t.Fatal(err)
                    }

                    expect := func(addedSkis, addedPeople, rented int) {
                        t.Helper()
                        w := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/dashboard", "", nil, 200)
                        var got store.DashboardCounts
                        if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &got); err != nil {
                            t.Fatal(err)
                        }
                        want := store.DashboardCounts{AvailableSkis: baseline.TotalSkis + addedSkis - rented, RentedSkis: rented, TotalSkis: baseline.TotalSkis + addedSkis, RegisteredPeople: baseline.RegisteredPeople + addedPeople}
                        if got != want {
                            t.Fatalf("dashboard=%+v want=%+v", got, want)
                        }
                    }
                    expect(0, 0, 0)
                    skiResponse := call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"MVP Testpaar"}`), 201)
                    var ski domain.Ski
                    if err := json.Unmarshal(skiResponse.Body.Bytes(), &ski); err != nil {
                        t.Fatal(err)
                    }
                    if ski.ID == "" || ski.Name != "MVP Testpaar" {
                        t.Fatal("missing generated ski data")
                    }
                    expect(1, 0, 0)
                    fields := map[string]string{"name": "MVP Testperson", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Reisepass", "documentNumber": "SYNTHETISCH-MVP"}
                    var photo []byte
                    mime := ""
                    if proof != "manual" {
                        fields = map[string]string{"name": "MVP Testperson", "proof": "photo"}
                        photo, err = os.ReadFile("../../testdata/ausweis-demo.png")
                        if err != nil {
                            t.Fatal(err)
                        }
                        mime = "image/png"
                        if proof == "jpeg" {
                            img, err := png.Decode(bytes.NewReader(photo))
                            if err != nil {
                                t.Fatal(err)
                            }
                            var encoded bytes.Buffer
                            if err := jpeg.Encode(&encoded, img, nil); err != nil {
                                t.Fatal(err)
                            }
                            photo = encoded.Bytes()
                            mime = "image/jpeg"
                        }
                    }
                    response := personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", fields, photo, mime, 201)
                    var person domain.Person
                    if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &person); err != nil {
                        t.Fatal(err)
                    }
                    if person.ID == "" || person.Name != "MVP Testperson" {
                        t.Fatal("missing generated person data")
                    }
                    expect(1, 1, 0)
                    detail := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen/"+person.ID, "", nil, 200)
                    if proof == "manual" {
                        if !strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "SYNTHETISCH-MVP") {
                            t.Fatal("manual proof missing")
                        }
                    } else {
                        if person.PhotoURL == "" {
                            t.Fatal("photo URL missing")
                        }
                        gotPhoto := call(t, app, "GET", person.PhotoURL, "", nil, 200)
                        if gotPhoto.Header().Get("Content-Type") != mime || !bytes.Equal(photo, gotPhoto.Body.Bytes()) {
                            t.Fatal("photo not preserved")
                        }
                    }
                    people := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen", "", nil, 200)
                    for _, private := range []string{"documentNumber", "documentType", "photoURL", "SYNTHETISCH-MVP"} {
                        if strings.Contains(people.Body.String(), private) {
                            t.Fatal("overview exposed proof")
                        }
                    }
                    if !demo {
                        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/tarife", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"version":0,"pricesCents":[2500,4500,6000],"extraDayCents":1500}`), 200)
                    }
                    input := []byte(bookingBody(person.ID, ski.ID, 1))
                    create := func() rentalResponse {
                        t.Helper()
                        w := call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ausleihen", "application/json", bytes.NewReader(input), 201)
                        var rental rentalResponse
                        if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &rental); err != nil {
                            t.Fatal(err)
                        }
                        if rental.PersonID != person.ID || rental.SkiID != ski.ID || rental.PersonName != person.Name || rental.SkiName != ski.Name || rental.ReturnedAt != nil {
                            t.Fatal("rental references wrong records")
                        }
                        return issueHTTP(t, app, rental.ID)

                    first := create()
                    expect(1, 1, 1)
                    call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ausleihen", "application/json", bytes.NewReader(input), 409)
                    expect(1, 1, 1)
                    available := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/verfuegbar", "", nil, 200)
                    if strings.Contains(available.Body.String(), ski.ID) {
                        t.Fatal("rented pair still selectable")
                    }
                    path := "/api/ausleihen/" + first.ID + "/rueckgabe"
                    returned := call(t, app, "PUT", path, "", nil, 200)
                    expect(1, 1, 0)
                    repeat := call(t, app, "PUT", path, "", nil, 200)
                    if returned.Body.String() != repeat.Body.String() {
                        t.Fatal("repeated return changed timestamp")
                    }
                    expect(1, 1, 0)
                    available = call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/verfuegbar", "", nil, 200)
                    if !strings.Contains(available.Body.String(), ski.ID) {
                        t.Fatal("returned pair not available")
                    }
                    next := create()
                    if next.ID == first.ID {
                        t.Fatal("rental ID reused")
                    }
                    expect(1, 1, 1)
                    call(t, app, "PUT", path, "", nil, 200)
                    expect(1, 1, 1)
                    call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ausleihen/"+next.ID+"/rueckgabe", "", nil, 200)
                    expect(1, 1, 0)
                    history := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ausleihen", "", nil, 200)
                    var records []rentalResponse
                    if err := json.Unmarshal(history.Body.Bytes(), &records); err != nil {
                        t.Fatal(err)
                    }
                    if len(records) != 2 || records[0].ReturnedAt == nil || records[1].ReturnedAt == nil {
                        t.Fatal("returned history incomplete")
                    }
                    page := call(t, app, "GET", "/", "", nil, 200)
                    if !strings.Contains(page.Body.String(), fmt.Sprintf(`data-metric="totalSkis">%d</strong>`, baseline.TotalSkis+1)) {
                        t.Fatal("HTML dashboard out of sync")
                    }
                    if store.New(demo).Dashboard() != baseline {
                        t.Fatal("fresh start inherited scenario data")
                    }
                })
            }
        }
    }

    package store
    
    import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "sort"
    
        "bikerental/internal/domain"
    )
    
    var ErrUnavailable = errors.New("Das Ski-Paar ist im gewählten Zeitraum bereits gebucht. Bitte ein anderes Paar oder einen anderen Zeitraum auswählen.")
    
    type MissingReference struct{ Field string }
    
    func (e MissingReference) Error() string { return "Der ausgewählte Datensatz wurde nicht gefunden." }
    func (e MissingReference) Unwrap() error { return ErrNotFound }
    
    // RentalDetails joins current names under the same lock without identity evidence.
    type RentalDetails struct {
        Today      string
        Rental     domain.Rental
        PersonName string
        SkiName    string
    }
    
    func (s *Store) rentalDetailsLocked(r domain.Rental) RentalDetails {
        return RentalDetails{Today: domain.Today(s.now()), Rental: r, PersonName: s.people[r.PersonID].Name, SkiName: s.skis[r.SkiID].Name}
    }
    func (s *Store) availablePeriodLocked(skiID, start, end string) bool {
        for _, r := range s.rentals {
            if r.SkiID == skiID && r.BlocksPeriod() && r.StartsOn <= end && start <= r.EndsOn {
                return false
            }
        }
        return true
    }
    func (s *Store) AvailableSkis() []domain.Ski {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        // Build once rather than scanning the rental history for every pair.
        active := make(map[string]bool)
        for _, r := range s.rentals {
            if r.Active() {
                active[r.SkiID] = true
            }
        }
        result := make([]domain.Ski, 0, len(s.skis))
        for id, ski := range s.skis {
            if !active[id] {
                result = append(result, ski)
            }
        }
        sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].ID < result[j].ID })
        return result
    }
    
    // CreateRental validates price, references and overlap in one atomic operation.
    func (s *Store) CreateRental(personID, skiID, start, end string, version uint64) (RentalDetails, error) {
        personID, skiID, err := domain.ValidateRentalReferences(personID, skiID)
        if err != nil {
            return RentalDetails{}, err
        }
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        if _, ok := s.people[personID]; !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, MissingReference{Field: "personID"}
        }
        if _, ok := s.skis[skiID]; !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, MissingReference{Field: "skiID"}
        }
        quote, err := s.quoteLocked(start, end)
        if err != nil {
            return RentalDetails{}, err
        }
        if version != quote.TariffVersion {
            return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"tariffVersion", "Der Tarif wurde geändert. Bitte den neuen Preis prüfen und erneut bestätigen."}
        }
        if !s.availablePeriodLocked(skiID, start, end) {
            return RentalDetails{}, ErrUnavailable
        }
        s.nextRental++
        r := domain.Rental{ID: fmt.Sprintf("ausleihe-%06d", s.nextRental), PersonID: personID, SkiID: skiID,
            CreatedAt: s.now().UTC(), StartsOn: start, EndsOn: end, DurationDays: quote.DurationDays,
            TotalPriceCents: quote.TotalPriceCents, TariffVersion: quote.TariffVersion}
        s.rentals[r.ID] = r
        return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
    }
    
    func (s *Store) AvailableFor(start, end string) ([]domain.Ski, error) {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        if _, err := domain.PeriodDays(start, end, domain.Today(s.now())); err != nil {
            return nil, err
        }
        result := []domain.Ski{}
        for id, ski := range s.skis {
            if s.availablePeriodLocked(id, start, end) {
                result = append(result, ski)
            }
        }
        sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].ID < result[j].ID })
        return result, nil
    }
    func (s *Store) IssueRental(id string) (RentalDetails, error) {
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        r, ok := s.rentals[id]
        if !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        if !r.CancelledAt.IsZero() {
            return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"form", "Eine stornierte Buchung kann nicht ausgegeben werden."}
        }
        if !r.RentedAt.IsZero() {
            return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
        }
        today := domain.Today(s.now())
        if today < r.StartsOn || today > r.EndsOn {
            return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"form", "Die Ausgabe ist nur innerhalb des gebuchten Zeitraums möglich."}
        }
        for _, other := range s.rentals {
            if other.SkiID == r.SkiID && other.Active() {
                return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"form", "Das Ski-Paar wurde aus einer vorherigen Ausleihe noch nicht zurückgegeben."}
            }
        }
        r.RentedAt = s.now().UTC()
        s.rentals[id] = r
        return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
    }
    func (s *Store) CancelRental(id string) (RentalDetails, error) {
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        r, ok := s.rentals[id]
        if !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        if !r.RentedAt.IsZero() {
            return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"form", "Eine bereits ausgegebene Ausleihe kann nicht storniert werden."}
        }
        if r.CancelledAt.IsZero() {
            r.CancelledAt = s.now().UTC()
            s.rentals[id] = r
        }
        return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
    }
    func (s *Store) ReturnRental(id string) (RentalDetails, error) {
        s.mu.Lock()
        defer s.mu.Unlock()
        r, ok := s.rentals[id]
        if !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        if r.RentedAt.IsZero() {
            return RentalDetails{}, Conflict{"form", "Eine Rückgabe ist erst nach der Ausgabe möglich."}
        }
        if r.Active() {
            r.ReturnedAt = s.now().UTC()
            s.rentals[id] = r
        }
        return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
    }
    func (s *Store) Rental(id string) (RentalDetails, error) {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        r, ok := s.rentals[id]
        if !ok {
            return RentalDetails{}, ErrNotFound
        }
        return s.rentalDetailsLocked(r), nil
    }
    func (s *Store) Rentals() []RentalDetails {
        s.mu.RLock()
        defer s.mu.RUnlock()
        result := make([]RentalDetails, 0, len(s.rentals))
        for _, r := range s.rentals {
            result = append(result, s.rentalDetailsLocked(r))
        }
        sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].Rental.ID < result[j].Rental.ID })
        return result
    }

    func exposeRental(d store.RentalDetails) rentalResponse {
        r := d.Rental
        return rentalResponse{ID: r.ID, PersonID: r.PersonID, SkiID: r.SkiID, PersonName: d.PersonName, SkiName: d.SkiName,
            CreatedAt: r.CreatedAt, StartsOn: r.StartsOn, EndsOn: r.EndsOn, DurationDays: r.DurationDays, TotalPriceCents: r.TotalPriceCents,
            TariffVersion: r.TariffVersion, Status: r.Status(d.Today), Overdue: r.Active() && r.EndsOn < d.Today,
            RentedAt: optionalTime(r.RentedAt), ReturnedAt: optionalTime(r.ReturnedAt), CancelledAt: optionalTime(r.CancelledAt)}
    }
    
    // readJSON bounds all writes and rejects fields the endpoint does not own.
    func readJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, input any) bool {
        media, _, _ := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
        if media != "application/json" {
            writeJSON(w, 415, map[string]any{"errors": domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "JSON erwartet."}})
            return false
        }
        r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64*1024)
        dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
        dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
        if err := dec.Decode(input); err != nil {
            apiError(w, err)
            return false
        }
        if err := dec.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
            if err == nil {
                err = errors.New("extra JSON")
            }
            apiError(w, err)
            return false
        }
        return true
    }
    func registerRentals(mux *http.ServeMux, s *store.Store) {
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/tarife", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { writeJSON(w, 200, s.Tariff()) })
        mux.HandleFunc("PUT /api/tarife", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            var input struct {
                Version       *uint64  `json:"version"`
                PricesCents   []*int64 `json:"pricesCents"`
                ExtraDayCents *int64   `json:"extraDayCents"`
            }
            if !readJSON(w, r, &input) {
                return
            }
            if input.Version == nil || input.ExtraDayCents == nil {
                apiError(w, domain.ValidationErrors{"form": "Tarifversion und Zusatztagspreis sind erforderlich."})
                return
            }
            tariff := domain.Tariff{Version: *input.Version, ExtraDayCents: *input.ExtraDayCents}
            for _, price := range input.PricesCents {
                if price == nil {
                    apiError(w, domain.ValidationErrors{"pricesCents": "Jeder Tagespreis muss eine ganze Centzahl sein."})
                    return
                }
                tariff.PricesCents = append(tariff.PricesCents, *price)
            }
            result, err := s.SaveTariff(tariff)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, result)
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/ausleihen/preis", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            var input struct {
                StartsOn string `json:"startsOn"`
                EndsOn   string `json:"endsOn"`
            }
            if !readJSON(w, r, &input) {
                return
            }
            result, err := s.Quote(input.StartsOn, input.EndsOn)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, result)
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/ski/verfuegbar", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            q := r.URL.Query()
            if q.Has("startsOn") || q.Has("endsOn") {
                result, err := s.AvailableFor(q.Get("startsOn"), q.Get("endsOn"))
                if err != nil {
                    apiError(w, err)
                    return
                }
                writeJSON(w, 200, result)
            } else {
                writeJSON(w, 200, s.AvailableSkis())
            }
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/ausleihen", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            result := []rentalResponse{}
            for _, detail := range s.Rentals() {
                result = append(result, exposeRental(detail))
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, result)
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("GET /api/ausleihen/{id}", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            result, err := s.Rental(r.PathValue("id"))
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            writeJSON(w, 200, exposeRental(result))
        })
        mux.HandleFunc("POST /api/ausleihen", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
            var input struct {
                PersonID      string  `json:"personID"`
                SkiID         string  `json:"skiID"`
                StartsOn      string  `json:"startsOn"`
                EndsOn        string  `json:"endsOn"`
                TariffVersion *uint64 `json:"tariffVersion"`
            }
            if !readJSON(w, r, &input) {
                return
            }
            if _, _, err := domain.ValidateRentalReferences(input.PersonID, input.SkiID); err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            if input.TariffVersion == nil {
                apiError(w, domain.ValidationErrors{"tariffVersion": "Bitte zuerst den Preis prüfen und bestätigen."})
                return
            }
            result, err := s.CreateRental(input.PersonID, input.SkiID, input.StartsOn, input.EndsOn, *input.TariffVersion)
            if err != nil {
                apiError(w, err)
                return
            }
            w.Header().Set("Location", "/api/ausleihen/"+result.Rental.ID)
            writeJSON(w, 201, exposeRental(result))
        })
        for action, operation := range map[string]func(string) (store.RentalDetails, error){"ausgabe": s.IssueRental, "rueckgabe": s.ReturnRental, "stornierung": s.CancelRental} {
            mux.HandleFunc("PUT /api/ausleihen/{id}/"+action, func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 64*1024))
                if err != nil {
                    apiError(w, err)
                    return
                }
                if len(body) != 0 {
                    apiError(w, errors.New("unexpected action body"))
                    return
                }
                result, err := operation(r.PathValue("id"))
                if err != nil {
                    apiError(w, err)
                    return
                }
                writeJSON(w, 200, exposeRental(result))
            })
        }
    }

    func call(t *testing.T, app http.Handler, method, path, kind string, body io.Reader, status int) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
        t.Helper()
        r := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, body)
        if kind != "" {
            r.Header.Set("Content-Type", kind)
        }
        w := httptest.NewRecorder()
        app.ServeHTTP(w, r)
        if w.Code != status {
            t.Fatalf("%s %s: got %d want %d: %s", method, path, w.Code, status, w.Body.String())
        }
        if w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
            t.Fatal("missing cache protection")
        }
        return w
    }
    func personRequest(t *testing.T, app http.Handler, method, path string, fields map[string]string, photo []byte, mime string, status int) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
        t.Helper()
        var b bytes.Buffer
        writer := multipart.NewWriter(&b)
        for k, v := range fields {
            if err := writer.WriteField(k, v); err != nil {
                t.Fatal(err)
            }
        }
        if photo != nil {
            h := textproto.MIMEHeader{}
            h.Set("Content-Disposition", `form-data; name="photo"; filename="synthetic.png"`)
            h.Set("Content-Type", mime)
            part, err := writer.CreatePart(h)
            if err != nil {
                t.Fatal(err)
            }
            _, _ = part.Write(photo)
        }
        _ = writer.Close()
        return call(t, app, method, path, writer.FormDataContentType(), &b, status)
    }
    func TestManagementAPI(t *testing.T) {
        s := store.New(false)
        app, err := New(s)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        ski := call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":" Test Ski "}`), 201)
        var sk domain.Ski
        _ = json.Unmarshal(ski.Body.Bytes(), &sk)
        if sk.Name != "Test Ski" || ski.Header().Get("Location") != "/api/ski/"+sk.ID {
            t.Fatal("ski creation")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "", nil, 200)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"Edited"}`), 200)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/"+sk.ID, "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":" "}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X","id":"override"}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X"} {}`), 400)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "text/plain", strings.NewReader(`{}`), 415)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski/missing", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "PUT", "/api/ski/missing", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"X"}`), 404)
        fields := map[string]string{"name": " Synthetic Person ", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Sonstiger Ausweis", "documentDescription": "Testdokument", "documentNumber": "TEST-42"}
        created := personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", fields, nil, "", 201)
        var p domain.Person
        _ = json.Unmarshal(created.Body.Bytes(), &p)
        path := "/api/personen/" + p.ID
        if p.Name != "Synthetic Person" || created.Header().Get("Location") != path {
            t.Fatal("person creation")
        }
        detail := call(t, app, "GET", path, "", nil, 200)
        if !strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "TEST-42") {
            t.Fatal("detail missing proof")
        }
        list := call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen", "", nil, 200)
        var summaries []map[string]any
        _ = json.Unmarshal(list.Body.Bytes(), &summaries)
        if len(summaries) != 1 || len(summaries[0]) != 2 {
            t.Fatal("list exposes extra fields")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "Renamed", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 200)
        before := s.Snapshot()
        for _, bad := range []map[string]string{
            {"name": " ", "proof": "keep"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Unknown", "documentNumber": "X"},
            {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Reisepass"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "documentType": "Sonstiger Ausweis", "documentNumber": "X"},
            {"name": "X", "proof": "keep", "documentNumber": "X"}, {"name": "X", "proof": "photo"},
        } {
            personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, bad, nil, "", 400)
            if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
                t.Fatal("invalid edit mutated state")
            }
        }
        var pic bytes.Buffer
        _ = png.Encode(&pic, image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 2, 2)))
        photoFields := map[string]string{"name": "Photo Person", "proof": "photo"}
        for _, tc := range []struct {
            data   []byte
            mime   string
            status int
        }{
            {[]byte("broken"), "image/png", 400}, {pic.Bytes(), "image/jpeg", 400}, {pic.Bytes()[:len(pic.Bytes())-15], "image/png", 400}, {make([]byte, domain.MaxPhotoBytes+1), "image/png", 413},
        } {
            personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, photoFields, tc.data, tc.mime, tc.status)
            if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
                t.Fatal("invalid photo mutated state")
            }
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, photoFields, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 200)
        imageResponse := call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
        if !bytes.Equal(imageResponse.Body.Bytes(), pic.Bytes()) || imageResponse.Header().Get("Content-Type") != "image/png" {
            t.Fatal("wrong photo response")
        }
        detail = call(t, app, "GET", path, "", nil, 200)
        if strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "TEST-42") || !strings.Contains(detail.Body.String(), "photoURL") {
            t.Fatal("photo switch retained manual proof")
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "Photo renamed", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 200)
        imageResponse = call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
        if !bytes.Equal(imageResponse.Body.Bytes(), pic.Bytes()) {
            t.Fatal("keep changed photo")
        }
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, fields, nil, "", 200)
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", "/api/personen/missing", fields, nil, "", 404)
        personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 400)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen/missing", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/personen/missing/foto", "", nil, 404)
        call(t, app, "DELETE", path, "", nil, 405)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{}`), 415)
        // A fresh process-local state never inherits edits or photos.
        if len(store.New(false).People()) != 0 {
            t.Fatal("fresh store inherited data")
        }
    }
    
    func TestMultipartBoundariesAndPhotoCreation(t *testing.T) {
        s := store.New(false)
        app, err := New(s)
        if err != nil {
            t.Fatal(err)
        }
        var pic bytes.Buffer
        _ = png.Encode(&pic, image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 2, 2)))
        fields := map[string]string{"name": "Photo creation", "proof": "photo"}
        created := personRequest(t, app, "POST", "/api/personen", fields, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 201)
        var p domain.Person
        _ = json.Unmarshal(created.Body.Bytes(), &p)
        if p.PhotoURL == "" {
            t.Fatal("photo creation missing URL")
        }
        before := s.Snapshot()
        path := "/api/personen/" + p.ID
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "keep"}, []byte{}, "image/png", 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "photo", "documentType": "Reisepass", "documentNumber": "X"}, pic.Bytes(), "image/png", 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": "X", "proof": "manual", "id": "override"}, nil, "", 400)
        var body bytes.Buffer
        writer := multipart.NewWriter(&body)
        _ = writer.WriteField("name", "A")
        _ = writer.WriteField("name", "B")
        _ = writer.Close()
        call(t, app, "PUT", path, writer.FormDataContentType(), &body, 400)
        call(t, app, "PUT", path, "multipart/form-data; boundary=broken", strings.NewReader("truncated"), 400)
        personRequest(t, app, "PUT", path, map[string]string{"name": strings.Repeat("x", 9000), "proof": "keep"}, nil, "", 413)
        call(t, app, "POST", "/api/ski", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"`+strings.Repeat("x", 70000)+`"}`), 413)
        if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, s.Snapshot()) {
            t.Fatal("malformed request mutated state")
        }
        call(t, app, "GET", "/api/ski", "", nil, 200)
        call(t, app, "GET", path+"/foto", "", nil, 200)
    }
